menu.name: Chicken Karahi

content.heroSubheadline: Stay Royal. Dine Exquisitely. Celebrate Beautifully.
content.promotionalAnnouncement: Special Pilgrimage & NH-19 Traveler Package: 15% off weekday deluxe stays with complimentary highway breakfast.
content.aboutStoryHeading: Three Decades of Unrivalled Grand Trunk Road Hospitality
content.aboutStoryParagraph1: Founded on the legendary Grand Trunk Road (now NH-19), Shaan-E-Punjab Hotel & Resort has welcomed weary travelers, spiritual pilgrims journeying to Shikharji Parasnath, and celebration seekers across generations.
content.aboutStoryParagraph2: What started as a revered highway dhaba renowned for slow-cooked Dal Makhani and tandoori roti has evolved into a premier 4-star destination featuring air-conditioned suites, a 1,500-capacity marriage garden, and tranquil views of Parasnath foothills.
content.highwaySanctuaryDesc: Safe, CCTV-monitored parking and 24-hour kitchen for travelers driving the Delhi-Kolkata corridor.
